title: Ordinary Polynomial Multiplication over Fixed Finite Fields in O(n log n) Time
author: Árpád Csizmadia
status: research preprint open for mathematical review
abstract_tex: For every individually fixed finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, we derive ordinary dense polynomial multiplication in $O_q(n\log(n+2))$ deterministic bit time on a fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with a fixed finite number of sequential tapes. The characteristic-two branch uses the accompanying Pascal-transform binary multiplier; the odd-prime branch weakens the accompanying exponent $9999/10000$. A fixed-basis expansion reduces a degree-$e$ extension to $e^2$ prime-field products and $O_q(n)$ encoding and recombination work, including ordinary coefficient input/output. This note records a baseline consequence of shared proof sources. Complete Lean formalization is unfinished.
comments: Baseline general companion. Uses the accessible binary theorem and the stronger general paper's odd-field proposition; does not invoke the principal binary saving. Substantial generative AI assistance. Full Lean formalization is unfinished and planned for later.

title: Ordinary Polynomial Multiplication over Every Fixed Finite Field
author: Árpád Csizmadia
status: research preprint open for mathematical review
abstract_tex: We combine ordinary polynomial multiplication constructions over individually fixed finite fields. The common deterministic bit-time bound is $O_q(n(\log(n+2))^{1-2^{-38}})$ on a fixed finite-tape machine. The characteristic-two input is the accompanying controlled-CRT construction, with a fixed-extension reduction. The odd-field cyclotomic-host argument gives the sharper exponent $0.9999$ for each fixed odd field, using named host, native-routing and stage-two interchange results. Field-dependent constants, ordinary coefficient input/output, and all representation and movement costs are explicit. No uniform growing-field or combined workspace claim is made.

title: Exact Binary Polynomial Multiplication from Fast Pascal Transforms
author: Árpád Csizmadia
status: research preprint open for mathematical review
abstract_tex: We give a written construction for exact ordinary polynomial multiplication over $\mathbb{F}_2$ in $O(n\log(n+2))$ deterministic bit time on fixed finite tapes, using a cited arbitrary-width tape-interchange theorem. Explicit cyclotomic fields, prefix Taylor evaluation, subfield scalar costs and a residue decoder account for ordinary coefficient input/output. A finite-field tensor construction supplies the Pascal transforms. The paper includes fixed-operand adjoints and a corollary for each fixed characteristic-two extension. Historical bounded witnesses check finite algebra and indexing only.

title: Ordinary Binary Polynomial Multiplication below n log n
author: Árpád Csizmadia
status: research preprint open for mathematical review
abstract_tex: We present a construction for ordinary binary polynomial multiplication in $O(n(\log(n+2))^{1-2^{-38}})$ deterministic bit time on a fixed finite-alphabet machine with a fixed number of sequential tapes. Controlled tensor routing, ragged parity networks, a balanced coupled CRT tree, a cyclotomic coefficient host and an exact-width Fourier compiler account for ordinary input and all product coefficients. The appendices supply the interchange, finite-phase, native endpoint and local arithmetic arguments. The paper cites the exact prior host, arithmetic and interchange results used. A corollary treats each fixed characteristic-two extension; no growing-field uniformity or practical speedup is claimed.
